usedFor: Woodpecker runs cold email campaigns, and Google Docs holds the notes that “Add or Replace Text In Tab” writes.

bestTemplate.name: “Prospect Replied” in Woodpecker, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A reply is the signal worth keeping, and it can be written into a Doc tab for whoever follows up.

watchOut: “Prospect Saved” fires when a prospect is created or updated, so one prospect can write to the tab twice.
